content: The use of pretomanid is associated with a risk of hepatotoxicity. It is strongly advised to avoid alcohol and other hepatotoxic agents, including herbal supplements and drugs, except for bedaquiline and linezolid, when using pretomanid. Specific drug interactions and recommendations are as follows: 1. Testosterone (intranasal or topical): Co-administration with pretomanid may increase the toxicity of either drug. Avoid or use an alternative drug. Pretomanid is linked to hepatotoxicity, so alcohol and hepatotoxic agents should be avoided. 2. Thioguanine: Co-administration with pretomanid may increase toxicity. Avoid or use an alternative drug. Monitor for hepatotoxicity and avoid alcohol or hepatotoxic agents. 3. Ticlopidine: Co-administration with pretomanid may increase toxicity. Avoid or use an alternative drug. Pretomanid is associated with hepatotoxicity, so alcohol and hepatotoxic agents should be avoided. 4. Valproic acid: Co-administration with pretomanid may increase toxicity. Avoid or use an alternative drug. Monitor for hepatotoxicity and avoid alcohol or hepatotoxic agents. 5. Vitamin A and Vitamin D: Co-administration with pretomanid may increase toxicity. Avoid or use an alternative drug. Pretomanid is associated with hepatotoxicity, so alcohol and hepatotoxic agents should be avoided. 6. Adefovir: Pretomanid increases the level or effect of adefovir by inhibiting OAT3. Therapy should be modified, and close monitoring is required. Consider dosage reduction for OAT3 substrates. 7. Atogepant: Pretomanid increases the level or effect of atogepant. Use caution and monitor closely for drug-related adverse effects, especially with sensitive OATP1B3 substrates. 8. Baricitinib: Pretomanid increases the level or effect of baricitinib by inhibiting OAT3. Therapy should be modified, and close monitoring is required. Consider dosage reduction for OAT3 substrates. 9. Bosentan: Pretomanid increases the level or effect of bosentan. Use caution and monitor closely for adverse effects. Conversely, bosentan decreases the level or effect of pretomanid by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 10.
